as_told.title: Lue Elizondo's book: warp bubble discussed with Hal Puthoff

plain: Eric Burlison, a US congressman, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a book by Lue Elizondo, a former Pentagon official. Burlison says the book explains that the odd shapes of reported craft make sense if they carry some kind of anti-gravity device that wraps them in a bubble. If true, it would mean the shapes are a clue to how these craft fly.
